sources.summary: Nous Research has added /learn to the Hermes Agent Skills System. The command authors a standards-compliant SKILL.md from a local directory, a doc URL, a past conversation, or pasted notes. The live agent sources the material with its own tools, then writes the skill — no hand-writing and no separate ingestion engine. Here is how it works, where it fits, and what to review before trusting the output.
